Diagnosis.submission: The rate service in the hotel-reservation namespace has its RATE_BACKEND_QPS_LIMIT set to 20, which is far too low to handle the workload. The search service (60% of traffic) makes gRPC calls to the rate service for rate limit checking, but the rate limiter at 20 QPS causes the queue (capacity 256) to fill up completely. This results in requests being rejected with ResourceExhausted or expiring with DeadlineExceeded, causing ~94% of search-to-rate calls to fail. The root cause is the artificially low QPS limit of 20 on the rate service backend rate limiter.
